text:
ITEM 1 | Heap of small diced pieces in orange-yellow, red, green and pale cream colors, with yellow corn kernels, diced red bell pepper, diced green pepper and small pale cubes (likely diced cucumber or similar crisp vegetable), mixed with shredded pale yellow-green leafy strips, moist and glossy-looking, piled loosely in the upper-left portion of a white square plate; the heap is roughly 10 cm wide and 9 cm tall on the plate, about 2 to 3 cm high at its peak | 110

ITEM 2 | Thin, translucent pale yellow-green crinkled leafy strips with wavy edges, scattered through and draped over the heap, some lying flat, soft and limp with slight sheen, sitting on the white plate with a few torn pieces extending to the right edge of the heap, about 4 cm long each | 15

ITEM 3 | Small scattered pieces of pale yellow-green crisp cubes and a few bright orange corn kernels spilled at the lower edge of the heap, on the white plate surface, sparse and flat, about 1 to 2 cm each | 8
